# mkreadme

Render GitHub READMEs from Jinja2 templates with badge and screenshot helpers.

[![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/mkreadme)](https://pypi.org/project/mkreadme/) [![Python](https://img.shields.io/pypi/pyversions/mkreadme)](https://pypi.org/project/mkreadme/) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Garulf/mkreadme)](https://github.com/Garulf/mkreadme/blob/main/LICENSE) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/Garulf/mkreadme/ci.yml)](https://github.com/Garulf/mkreadme/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![pre-commit](https://img.shields.io/badge/pre--commit-enabled-brightgreen?logo=pre-commit)](https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit) [![Ruff](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/astral-sh/ruff/main/assets/badge/v2.json)](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff)

## Installation

```sh
pip install mkreadme
```

Or with [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):

```sh
uv tool install mkreadme
```

## Quick start

```sh
cd my-repo
mkreadme init      # writes readme.yaml + README.md.j2 (autodetects owner/repo, name, license, ...)
mkreadme render    # writes README.md (--watch to re-render on change, -o - for stdout)
mkreadme check     # exit 1 with a diff if README.md is stale (use as a pre-commit hook / in CI)
mkreadme badges    # list badge presets
mkreadme blocks    # list overridable blocks and partials
mkreadme show partials/install.md.j2   # print a packaged template to copy and tweak
```

Already have a README? `mkreadme init --from-readme` moves its body into the template so nothing is
lost, then takes over `README.md`. Prefer `pyproject.toml`? `mkreadme init --pyproject` writes the config
to `[tool.readme]`.

`README.md.j2` extends the packaged `base.md.j2` and overrides only what it needs:

```jinja
{% extends "base.md.j2" %}

{% block usage %}
## Usage

{{ screenshot("main", width=600) }}

Run `{{ project.name }} --help`.
{% endblock %}
```

## Template helpers

| Helper | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `badge("pypi")`, `badge("ci", workflow="test.yml")` | Preset badge built from repo metadata |
| `shield("Discord", "chat", "5865F2", link=...)` | Custom shields.io static badge |
| `badges()` / `donate_badges()` | All badges from `badges:` / `donate:` in config |
| `screenshot("main", alt=..., width=...)` | Finds `docs/screenshots/main.{png,jpg,gif,webp,svg}`; `main-dark.*` + `main-light.*` become a theme-aware `<picture>` |
| `screenshots(columns=2)` | Gallery table of every image in the screenshots dir |
| `image("path/or/url", "alt", width=...)` | Explicit image, no discovery |
| `screenshots(order=[...], captions={...}, subdir=...)` | Control gallery order/captions (or drop a `captions.yaml` in the folder) |
| `toc()`, `toc(1, 2)` | Table of contents from the headings below it (min/max level) |
| `changelog(n=1)` | Newest `n` entries of `CHANGELOG.md` |
| `project.*`, `vars.*` | Repo metadata and free-form config values |

Badge presets: `pypi`, `pypi-downloads`, `python`, `license`, `ci`, `codecov`, `npm`, `github-release`,
`github-stars`, `pre-commit`, `ruff`, `version`, plus donation presets `kofi`, `buymeacoffee`, `github-sponsors`,
`patreon`, `paypal`. Add your own under `badges_custom`.

Blocks in `base.md.j2`: `header`, `badges`, `donate`, `toc`, `screenshots`, `install`, `usage`, `extra`,
`contributing`, `license`. Any packaged partial can be shadowed by a file of the same name under
`templates/partials/` in the repo (or `~/.config/mkreadme/templates/` for all your repos).

## Configuration

`readme.yaml` in the repo root (or `[tool.readme]` in `pyproject.toml`). Everything is optional;
metadata is autodetected from the git remote, the `LICENSE` file and whichever manifest the project
has: `pyproject.toml`, `package.json`, `Cargo.toml`, `go.mod`, `*.csproj`, Gradle (`gradle.properties`
mod metadata for Minecraft mods) or `hacs.json`. The install section adapts to the project type.

```yaml
template: README.md.j2
templates: [../shared-readme-templates, "pkg:my_org_templates"]   # extra template search paths
output: README.md
strict: false                     # missing screenshot -> error instead of warning
screenshots: {dir: docs/screenshots, width: 720, style: markdown}
badges: [pypi, python, license, {preset: ci, workflow: test.yml}]
badges_custom:
  discord: {label: Discord, message: chat, color: 5865F2, link: https://discord.gg/xyz}
donate: [kofi, github-sponsors]
donate_handles: {kofi: yourname, github-sponsors: yourname}
project: {name: ..., owner: ..., repo: ..., tagline: ..., pypi: ..., npm: ..., license: ..., ci_workflow: ...}
vars: {anything: you like}
```

Put the values you repeat across repos (donation handles, owner, custom badges) in
`~/.config/mkreadme/config.yaml`; `mkreadme init` bakes them into each new `readme.yaml` so rendering
stays reproducible in CI. `mkreadme render --user-config` merges them ad hoc.

## pre-commit and GitHub Actions

```yaml
# .pre-commit-config.yaml
- repo: https://github.com/Garulf/mkreadme
  rev: v0.2.0
  hooks:
    - id: mkreadme-check
```

```yaml
# .github/workflows/ci.yml
- uses: Garulf/mkreadme@v0.2.0
  with:
    mode: check     # or render
```
